exposure: preeclampsia with severe features and eclampsia
cohort: The study included 6365 women who gave birth at a tertiary care hospital in West Bengal, India.
finding: The proportion of cesarean sections was 36.07%, with previous CS being the primary indication, accounting for 39.50%.
mod_finding: The primary indication for cesarean section was previous CS, accounting for 39.50% of all CS cases.
